unreleased: Add Store Query.../Store Report... in-app editors to save the current filter or an existing favorite query as a favorite without hand-editing JSON
Add per-side relative dates (right-click a from/to calendar for "Today"/"Start of This Month"/etc.) and keep Periods-menu shortcuts self-updating in saved favorites instead of freezing today's range

Fix periodic charts: a period that bucked a topic's overall trend (e.g. a refund month in an otherwise expense-heavy category) was plotted as a positive magnitude on that topic's chart instead of offsetting the total

changes: Show what changed after an update, and on demand via Help → What's New
Fix What's New dialog: OK button clipped off-screen, and UTF-8 text (e.g. accented characters) rendered garbled
Add self-contained HTML reports (table + interactive charts) generated from favorite queries, via Reports → Favorite Reports
Fix charts: route each topic to income or expense by its net sum instead of showing it on both, and let a favorite report restrict which side(s) render via chart_sides
Fold long tails into an "Others" slice/series in report charts, and sort report tables/charts ascending by amount (Others always last)
Publish resources\ files (e.g. the HTML reports' Chart.js) with releases and sync them onto already-installed clients during self-update

Render HTML report tables as interactive Grid.js grids (sortable, searchable, paginated) instead of plain tables, with tighter row spacing and fixes for a permanent stray scrollbar and mangled chart-title text

Add Database → Prune Last Transactions..., a manual repair tool to remove an account's last N transactions with a preview and confirmation, for when a bad import/edit leaves the tail out of date order and breaks import's insertion-point search
Add logging around import file-format detection and stored-data alignment (PrepareImport), so a failed/empty import is now traceable in the log instead of silent

Fix MBH Bank CSV import broken by a source-encoding bug (missing UTF-8 BOM corrupted the header-sentinel literal) and by an unstripped UTF-8 BOM on the bank's own export files; also handle multi-line quoted CSV fields and preserve genuinely-empty trailing fields when splitting semicolon-separated values
Add debug logging of each imported row's raw CSV/XML fields alongside its parsed date/type/amount/client/memo
Support MBH Bank's expanded CSV export column layout (7 additional columns before Kiegeszitoinformacio)
Manual category resolve now offers the client's own previously-used categories as selection choices, with the most-used one pre-selected

Add BankAccountCli, a headless console tool that generates favorite reports read-only for scheduled/automated use, now also built and published to the release folder by PackageRelease.ps1 (outside the client update manifest)

Auto-recall a transaction's prior categorization when re-import or manual pruning removes it and a later import brings back the same date/amount/client, instead of asking again; fix a crash in PrepareImport when re-importing pops an account's entire transaction history
